messages.text: Jonah — thank you for making the trip to Harboridge. The team was impressed. You asked the right questions about the Kingswell split.
thank you for having me. I need a few days
Understood. Offer letter is with Mara. We need a yes or no by the 20th so we can stop the other search.
I'll be in touch. Please don't loop anyone at Northline
We won't. That's why we used Harbor Path.
